backend.description: Client-application architecture (per-client API/feature permissions, X-Client-Code resolution) with Access Control, Privilege, Layout, and License administration modules; application.properties credentials Jasypt-encrypted; system-module gap analysis and multi-tenant SaaS upgrade plans documented, not yet implemented.

jasyptEncrypt.description: Standalone helper (EncryptTool.java + encrypt.sh) for generating Jasypt ENC(...) values matching backend's JasyptConfig.java algorithm (PBEWITHHMACSHA512ANDAES_256, random salt+IV); not a separate repo, lives at tools/jasypt-encrypt in the root project.

keycloak.description: Dockerized Keycloak with a custom User Storage SPI backing logins with the app's own auth_user table instead of Keycloak's internal user store; Maven-built SPI module, run-keycloak-in-docker.sh, and setup documented in LOCAL_POSTGRES_DOCKER_KEYCLOAK.md.

kycFrontend21.description: Angular 21 standalone KYC frontend, client-application-aware (X-Client-Code): layout/theme sourced from backend config, dynamic form/wizard/list components, user-specific privilege-gated actions, dynamic document preview.

systemFrontend21.description: Angular 21 system-administration console (SYSTEM_ADMIN_WEB client): Access Control, Privileges, Layout Administration (navigation tree, UI/route policies), and License Administration (Plans, Subscriptions, Entitlements, Keys) modules.

frontendLibs21.description: Angular 21 shared component libraries (@nexacore/platform + @nexacore/shared): dynamic form/wizard/list with pagination, dynamic preview, privilege-gated UI directives, smart dropdown, shared authenticated layout shell.

sentinelKycAngularCld.description: Configurable enterprise layout shell (token-driven SCSS across 5 tiers, responsive nav, backend-driven layout-config.json) with a KYC demo built on top to exercise it end to end.

layout21.description: Enterprise navigation POC: module/submodule/feature hierarchy in dedicated tables, compliance/finance module groups, T-code quick nav, breadcrumb, /v1 API alignment for all endpoints.
